payload.description_html: The restoration of Foxaspis novemur gen. et sp. nov. (A) In dorsal view; (B) in ventral view; (C) in lateral view. Abbreviations: br.f, branchial fossa; br.o, branchial opening; di, digitation; dl, dorsal lobe; fw, fin web; md.o, median dorsal opening; obr.c, oralobranchial chamber; obr.f, oralobranchial fenestra; orb, orbital opening; se, serrated margin; vl, ventral lobe; vr, ventral rim.
